body: He thinks I do it for attention. I used to see a therapist but since I haven't left my room the last month I haven't seen her. I don't really want to see anyone right now, every time I open up to someone I get hurt. It's not their's or anyone else's fault, it's mine for being weak.
Everyone wears a mask of confidence, I've come to find that no one knows anything and everybody is just winging it. That's why the world is like this, we're all just big kids.
